walker_protocol_is_universal.insight: The same 6-step walker protocol works in EVERY state because the null leaks are the same
steps: WALK — find a flyer, a link, a QR code, a news article, a Reddit post
READ — follow the path through public records, court filings, school data
VERIFY — check sources independently (OIG reports, state data, FOIA)
GOSSIP — tell one person. The vine grows.
ACT — file one complaint. One FOIA. One call. One cell fills.
RETURN — bring back new knowledge. The mesh densifies.
walker_protocol_is_universal.convergence: O(log n) in every community. The protocol scales because the problem scales.

texas_fixed_it.rule: A person may NOT serve as board member, officer, or employee of a charter school if convicted of a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude or ANY felony
texas_fixed_it.implication: Under Texas law, Brian Banks could NOT operate a charter school. Under Michigan law, he does.
texas_fixed_it.fix: Michigan needs a Texas-style criminal history restriction for charter operators
